about.title: About the platform
about.intro: TəhsilRadar is a multilingual platform that helps students, graduates and young professionals find education and career opportunities in Azerbaijan and worldwide.
about.mission: Our aim is to gather scattered information in one place, point to the official source and help people decide in time. Opportunities from Azerbaijani government bodies, universities, banks, technology companies and non-governmental organizations are treated as equals to international ones.

sources.title: Data sources
sources.subtitle: The official sources of opportunities: an organization's own website, API or authorized feed.
sources.rules: Take data only from official sources. Prefer official APIs and authorized feeds where they exist, and respect each website's terms of use and technical restrictions. The platform never scrapes websites — a person records the date they checked the source.
sources.deleteConfirm: Delete this source? Imported opportunities are kept.

import.title: Import opportunities from CSV
import.subtitle: Check the file first, review every problem, then import only the valid rows as drafts.

template.help: The template has every column and one example row; the example row is never imported. Lists use | as separator. Dates: 2030-03-31 or 31.03.2030 (date only = end of that day in the organization's time zone). The organization must already exist (slug or exact name). The original language is az, ru or en; texts in the other languages go in the translation columns.

rules.title: Data-quality rules
rules.official: Every opportunity must have an official source URL.
rules.draft: Imported records are always created as unverified drafts and are never published automatically.
rules.nothing: Missing information is never invented: an empty cell stays empty.
rules.translations: Translations not marked as reviewed are stored as hidden machine drafts.
rules.active: A page that still exists does not make an opportunity active: the deadline and a person's check decide.

upload.tooLarge: The file is too large (1 MB at most).
